title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
abstract: arXiv:2607.06763v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal trees from the top-K marginals of a factorized drafter. Weaver restores conditional dependencies between proposed tokens while avoiding a full-vocabulary projection. To support fast verification for models with Gated Delta Net layers, we derive a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm and implement optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang. translated_title: 从边缘分布构建树：基于因子化先验的自回归草稿生成
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过以计算换取单次前向传播中额外生成的token，极大地提升了自回归语言模型的交互性。因子化草稿模型尤其高效，因为它们可以并行预测未来token的边缘分布，但其独立性假设导致随着投机预算的增长，接受率急剧下降。我们分析了这一局限性，并提出了Weaver——一个轻量级的自回归适配器，它从因子化草稿模型的top-K边缘分布中构建提议树。Weaver恢复了提议token之间的条件依赖关系，同时避免了全词表投影计算。为了支持对具有门控Delta Net（Gated Delta Net）层的模型进行快速验证，我们推导了一种无需回滚的树验证算法，并在SGLang中实现了优化的CUDA内核。通过结合这些模型与系统层面的贡献，我们相比自回归解码实现了4.08倍的加速。
tldr: 本文提出Weaver，一种从因子化草稿模型的top-K边缘分布构建提议树的轻量级自回归适配器，恢复了token间的条件依赖，并结合无需回滚的树验证算法与优化的CUDA内核，相比自回归解码实现了4.08倍加速。
en_tdlr: Weaver is a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal trees from the top-K marginals of a factorized drafter, restoring conditional dependencies and achieving a 4.08-fold speedup over autoregressive decoding through a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm and optimized CUDA kernels.
